title: REFORM-3D: A Representation-Centric Evaluation Framework for 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models
summary: REFORM-3D evaluates frozen 3D medical encoders for acquisition robustness, cross-modal anatomical alignment and anatomical transfer. In the controlled Med3DINO comparison, voxel-relative sampling reduced embedding drift while spacing-aware resampling favored anatomical transfer; advantages depended on dataset and feature type.
ai_technology: REFORM-3D evaluation framework; self-supervised Med3DINO encoder family
organization: Khalifa University; University of Western Australia

evidence.tested: Benchmarks across heterogeneous external encoders and multiple geometric regimes showed module-specific strengths; no single encoder ordering held across tasks.
evidence.unknown: This is a benchmark result on selected medical-imaging datasets and encoders; it does not establish clinical diagnostic benefit.
